svg.title: Dilation polynomial and zero-amplitude recovery. The slot readout retains q, its photon measure and both data functionals. Changing variables ui = 2ki gives a factor 2−2 from the measure and 2−(b+1) from the electric/energy power; d C2f±(ui) = bf±(ui/2) supplies the remaining test transformation.
